arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Bostwick argued the statute is a new sentence, not an exclamation point.
She stated the Veterans Court already reviewed benefit-of-the-doubt errors.
Mr. Joshi argued the court takes due account of the Secretary's application.
He noted most appeals raise factual challenges to disability findings.
